authoring_rationale: Class C, under-specified. The variants differ only in the standing rule of the Wing's rulebook from which the steward's decision power is said to come (rule 3 in one, rule 8 in the other). The rulebook is part of neither variant, so whether the steward's authority to decide this request, and any obligation attached to it, is the same under both rules cannot be determined. Engaged property: authority. Part D conditions: requires unavailable external authority (d) and insufficient source evidence (a). The case tempts equivalence by elimination (same steward, same date, same outcome) and a delta by the textual difference; neither is established from the visible text. Permission (the member may withdraw before the start), decision status (approved) and attribution (decided by the steward on the third) are the same.
